payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about previously reported results in the context of cue detection and scope resolution, including improvements in F1 scores over prior work.

claims.text: Previous work on cue detection and scope resolution reported results that varied from rule-based systems to deep learning approaches, with specific F1 score improvements noted in the current study.
The current study reports substantial improvements over previously reported results, with at least 0.29 F1 points on cue detection and 4.27 F1 points on scope resolution.
State-of-the-art results were reported for negation scope resolution, with increases of 3.16 F1 points on the BioScope Full Papers and 0.3 F1 points on the SFU Review Corpus.
